title: Merlyn Smith molding a flange in Glass Fabrication department
description: General view of Merlyn Smith molding a flange on a six-inch pipe manufactured in the Dow Chemical Company's Glass Fabrication department. Founded in 1925, the department was responsible for the fabrication and repair of specialty glass equipment used at the Company's plant in Midland, Michigan. In this photograph, the pipe is seen being rotated in a lathe to keep it properly aligned during the molding process.
author: Dow Chemical Company

Merlyn Smith molding a flange in Glass Fabrication department
General view of Merlyn Smith molding a flange on a six-inch pipe manufactured in the Dow Chemical Company's Glass Fabrication department. Founded in 1925, the department was responsible for the fabrication and repair of specialty glass equipment used at the Company's plant in Midland, Michigan. In this photograph, the pipe is seen being rotated in a lathe to keep it properly aligned during the molding process.
